messages.content: One HTML file. An icon of three stacked crates, flat angled faces, light from the upper left. No photo. No external file.

<think>
[frame: pathway=s2|mode=code|construct=coder|persona=neutral|identity=none|theme=none|channel=reasoning]
Three faces: the top is the lightest, the left is the midtone, the right is the shadow, which is what a light from the upper left does to a box. The points have to be a real isometric-looking diamond, not a rectangle with a gradient. viewBox keeps it sharp when scaled. A title inside the svg is the name. No raster, no stock photo of crates.
</think>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Crates</title>
<style>
body{margin:0;background:#f3f1ea;display:grid;place-items:center;min-height:100vh}svg{width:min(480px,90vw)}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 300 220" role="img"><title>Three crates</title><polygon points="150,40 230,80 150,120 70,80" fill="#f7f4ee"/><polygon points="70,80 150,120 150,180 70,140" fill="#c9c2b4"/><polygon points="230,80 150,120 150,180 230,140" fill="#8d877c"/></svg>
</body>
</html>
